name: app-in-chat-search-and-ai-features-five-screen-flow
title: Five chat screens: search default, results, no results, AI features and mentions
whatItIs: Five phones titled 'Chat Screens — In-Chat Search & AI': a search with filter chips (Messages, Groups, Photos, Links) and a 'No Results' empty state, a results list with the term highlighted, a skeleton loading state, a thread with an AI-highlighted purple message, and a thread showing mentions and tags.
whatItMeans: Thorough and systematic; covering every search state shows a production-ready flow.
techniques: Show default, results, loading and empty states side by side.
Use filter chips under the search field.
Highlight the matched term in results.

vocabulary.definition: Grey placeholder shapes shown while loading.
A small toggle button narrowing results.
